verdict.rationale: Cursor documents running many agents in parallel. Worktrees are designed so several agents can work on the same repo without conflicts, and the Agents Window, the IDE and the CLI all honor them. Cloud agents can be launched and managed from cursor.com/agents, and runs can be listed, streamed and cancelled through the API. However, the evidence only implies the Agents Window as a single management surface and never describes it in depth. missing for 10: detailed documentation of the unified Agents Window or dashboard for monitoring and steering multiple sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-session management.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can manage multiple agent-driven coding sessions from one unified workspace

citations.quote: Use worktrees when you want to start several agents on the same repo without conflicts
You can run as many agents as you want in parallel
Launch fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks for hours or days.
Runs support list/get/stream/cancel; agents support archive/unarchive/delete
